en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a large, stately building, possibly a manor or small palace, surrounded by leafless trees and a garden. There is a pathway leading up to the entrance, and several people can be seen near the steps. The style of the building and the barren trees suggest it is autumn or winter. The top center of the card contains red printed text.
